actors.name: Fran
actors.private_context: Fran posted the meal train sign-up to the neighborhood app on the evening of 2026-10-04. Eight slots were claimed that evening. Fran wants to fill all fourteen slots within four days to support the Okafor family.

actors.name: Neighbors on Alder Court
actors.private_context: The neighbors are a group of sixty households on Alder Court who use the neighborhood app. Some may have already signed up for a slot; others may not have seen the post yet or may be considering it. They have varying degrees of familiarity with the Okafor family and willingness to help.

shared_context: A meal train sign-up for the Okafor family (who just came home with newborn twins) was posted to the sixty-household neighborhood app by Fran on the evening of 2026-10-04. The sign-up has fourteen slots. As of 2026-10-05T09:00:00-04:00, eight slots have been claimed. The remaining six slots are open for any neighbor to claim. The app allows neighbors to see the sign-up and claim slots.

starting_events.description: The meal train sign-up has eight slots claimed and six slots remaining. Fran and the neighbors are aware of the sign-up.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that all fourteen slots of the meal train were claimed by 2026-10-09T09:00:00-04:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
